body: Dan Quinn faces a reported departure from the Washington Commanders following Stephen A. Smith's comments that his time there is over. While Quinn has hired a former head coach amid this uncertainty, no specific replacement or new team affiliation has been confirmed.

findings.evidence_quote: Stephen A. Smith Says Dan Quinn's Time in Washington Is Over as the Commanders Hit Their Bye
'It's over for Dan Quinn, this is it': Stephen A. Smith does not hold back on Commanders coach
